name: Statement of Work
description: A formal statement of work for an agreed engagement

required_sections.title: Cover Page
required_sections.description: Company and client logos, SOW title, version, date, signatories

required_sections.title: Parties
required_sections.description: Full legal names and addresses of both parties

required_sections.title: Background & Objectives
required_sections.description: Context for the engagement and what success looks like

required_sections.title: Scope of Services
required_sections.description: Detailed description of deliverables and activities included

required_sections.title: Out of Scope
required_sections.description: Explicit list of what is NOT included

required_sections.title: Deliverables
required_sections.description: Table of deliverables with acceptance criteria and due dates

required_sections.title: Responsibilities
required_sections.description: What each party is responsible for providing or doing

required_sections.title: Fees & Payment
required_sections.description: Fee schedule, payment milestones, and payment terms

required_sections.title: Change Control
required_sections.description: Process for requesting and approving scope changes
